project.name: home:kami911:nvidia-legacy:modules
project.title: NVIDIA legacy drivers — DKMS (Debian & Ubuntu, reproducible)
project.description: Reproducible DKMS packages for every legacy NVIDIA driver series (71/96/173/304/340/390/470xx). Source packages are rendered and checksum-pinned by CI in https://github.com/kami911/nvidia-legacy-modules ; OBS builds them in a clean chroot. Publishing is gated on the no-GPU test suite passing. Not affiliated with NVIDIA.
